name: HD Weapons
author: Sixth Front
description: Guns that feel real in your hands: they reflect the sky, brass flies out and stays on the ground, and barrels smoke after a long burst. (The guns themselves are modelled in detail in the game: M4A1, MP7, M249, AWM, Glock 19, a pump shotgun, RPG-7 and M203.)
script: // The guns' models are built into the game (js/guns.js). This mod adds the rest:
// reflections on your gun, brass that flies out and stays on the ground, and barrel smoke after a long burst.
const g = api.game, pc = g.playerCtl, fx = g.effects;
const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
// Older game versions: a hidden model's remove() runs when the mod is switched off
const h = api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01] }], { x: 0, y: -500, z: 0 });
// The gun in your hands reflects the sky, like everything else in the world
const before = { env: vm.environment, intensity: vm.environmentIntensity };
const size = shell ? 1.5 : def.model === 'pistol' ? 0.75 : def.model === 'smg' ? 0.85 : def.model === 'sniper' ? 1.35 : def.model === 'lmg' ? 1.1 : 1;
x: e.x + f.x * reach + rx * side, y: e.y + f.y * reach - (s.isPlayer ? 0.1 : 0.2), z: e.z + f.z * reach + rz * side,
sx: 0.011 * size, sy: 0.011 * size, sz: (shell ? 0.05 : 0.03) * size, life: 8, color: shell ? 0xa3261e : 0xc9a14a, rest: false,
// bolt-action rifles and pump guns throw the case out when the action is worked
// keep the viewmodel's reflections in step with the sky (mods can change the time of day)
// a wisp of smoke curls off a hot barrel once you stop shooting
